/*getSellerMpIvTranStatementWritePrintList_v2*/ SELECT X.*, CASE WHEN X.KTAG_YN = 'Y' THEN '품목라벨출력' WHEN X.TR_BUYER = 'KRKORE0068' AND NO_ITEMTAG_CHECK_YN = 'N' THEN '품목라벨출력' ELSE '' END AS SBUTTON2 FROM( SELECT S.BUYER_NAME , S.PO_CREATE_DATE , S.PO_NO , S.INV_NO , S.PO_AMT , S.DS_DATE , S.INVOICE_DATE , S.PO_REMARK , S.DS_ITEM_CNT , S.BUYER , S.SELLER , S.PROCESS_TYPE , S.LEGACY_PO_NO , S.REF_IF_NO , S.TR_BUYER , S.DELY_TO_LOCATION , S.ADD_USER_ID , S.DI_REMAIN_QTY , S.GR_REMAIN_QTY , S.DELIVERY_QTY , S.GR_QTY , S.REF_PR_NO , S.WMS_GR_QTY , S.BUYER2 , S.REF_NO , CASE WHEN NVL(S.PROCESS_TYPE,' ') = '0' THEN ( SELECT X.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL FROM ICOMIVHD X WHERE 1=1 AND X.BUYER = S.BUYER AND X.INV_NO = S.INV_NO AND NVL(X.STATUS,' ') != 'D' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) ELSE '' END AS LEGACY_INVOICE_KEY , DECODE(S.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','') AS BFRE_STCK_YN , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC||'('||USR.PHONE_NUMBER||')' FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = S.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_INFO , S.PARCEL_YN_TEXT , S.PARCEL_YN , S.INV_REMARK , S.RD_DATE , '거래명세서 출력' AS SBUTTON , CASE WHEN NVL(S.DELIVERY_QTY,0) > 0 OR NVL(S.GR_QTY,0) >0 THEN '납품완료' ELSE '납품실적 등록대상' END AS STATUS , CASE WHEN NVL(S.DELIVERY_QTY,0) > 0 OR NVL(S.GR_QTY,0) >0 THEN '/resources/imgs/State_04.png' ELSE '/resources/imgs/State_03.png' END AS STATUS_BUTTON , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(S.PORS_ADD_DATE||S.PORS_ADD_TIME,'yyyymmddhh24miss'),'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi') AS PORS_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(S.IVDT_ADD_DATE||S.IVDT_ADD_TIME,'yyyymmddhh24miss'),'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi') AS IVDT_DATE , TO_CHAR(S.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi') AS DELIVERY_ADD_DATE ,( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000054' --K TAG 사용 관리: 특수로직 AND B.COM_CODE = S.BUYER ) AS KTAG_YN ,S.PURCHASER_ID ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M204' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = S.BUYER) AS NO_TAG_CHECK_YN ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M206' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = S.BUYER) AS NO_ITEMTAG_CHECK_YN ,(SELECT COL01_DATA FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = S.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000034' ) AS P070000034 ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = S.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000032' ) AS SOLB_IF_BUYER ,S.IVDT_ADD_DATE ,S.DESCRIPTION_INFO ,DECODE(S.PROCESS_TYPE, '0', '직납', '2', 'TR(' || (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'W001' AND TEXT4 = 'B' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = S.TR_CENTER) || ')' , ' ') AS PROCESS_TYPE_TEXT ,(SELECT COL01_DATA FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = S.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'SIV00001' ) AS SIV00001_TYPE ,(SELECT COL02_DATA FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = S.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'SIV00001' ) AS SIV00001_RD1 ,(SELECT COL03_DATA FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = S.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'SIV00001' ) AS SIV00001_RD2 FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX(E ICOMIVHD_02) INDEX(D ICOMIVDT_03) */ MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(A.BUYER, '01'))) AS BUYER_NAME -- 1 구매사 , MAX(A.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE -- 2 발주일 , MAX(A.PO_NO) AS PO_NO -- 3 발주번호 , DECODE(COUNT(DISTINCT D.INV_NO), 1, MAX(D.INV_NO), 'plural_inv.gif') AS INV_NO -- 4 거래명세서번호 , SUM(DECODE(A.PR_TYPE,'PX', B.AGENT_PRICE, B.UNIT_PRICE)*D.INV_QTY) AS PO_AMT -- 5 납품총금액 , MIN(C.DS_DATE) DS_DATE -- 6 납품예정일 , MAX(D.INVOICE_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE -- 7 납품일 , MAX(DECODE(A.BUYER,'KREMK20001', DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','',A.PO_REMARK), A.PO_REMARK)) AS PO_REMARK -- 8 비고 , CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(D.DESCRIPTION) ELSE MIN(D.DESCRIPTION) || '외 ' || (COUNT(*)-1) || '건' END AS DESCRIPTION_INFO , COUNT(*) AS DS_ITEM_CNT -- 9 납품품목수 , D.BUYER AS BUYER -- 10 , MAX(B.SELLER) AS SELLER -- 11 , MAX(A.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE , MAX(DECODE(TRIM(B.LEGACY_PO_NO), NULL,'N',B.LEGACY_PO_NO)) AS LEGACY_PO_NO , MAX(B.REF_IF_NO) AS REF_IF_NO , MAX(DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',B.WAREHOUSE_CODE,B.BUYER)) AS TR_BUYER , MAX(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , MAX(A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID , (SUM(NVL(D.INV_QTY,0)) - SUM(NVL(D.DELIVERY_QTY,0))) AS DI_REMAIN_QTY , (SUM(NVL(D.INV_QTY,0)) - SUM(NVL(D.GR_QTY,0))) AS GR_REMAIN_QTY , SUM(NVL(D.DELIVERY_QTY,0)) AS DELIVERY_QTY , SUM(NVL(D.GR_QTY,0)) AS GR_QTY , MAX(B.REF_PR_NO) AS REF_PR_NO , SUM(NVL(D.WMS_GR_QTY,0)) AS WMS_GR_QTY , MAX(DECODE(A.DOC_TYPE,'X',DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',B.WAREHOUSE_CODE,F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, '01')),F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, '01'))) AS BUYER2 , MAX(F.REF_NO ) AS REF_NO --PX번호 , MAX(A.DOC_TYPE) AS DOC_TYPE , MAX((SELECT MAX(MNG.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_ID FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER AND MNG.PRIORITY = 'Y' AND MNG.STATUS != 'O')) AS KEP_USER_ID , DECODE(NVL(MAX(E.PARCEL_YN),MAX(A.PARCEL_YN)), 'Y', '택배', '자차') AS PARCEL_YN_TEXT ,NVL(MAX(E.PARCEL_YN),MAX(A.PARCEL_YN)) AS PARCEL_YN , MAX(E.REMARK_INV) AS INV_REMARK , MIN(B.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE , MIN(C.ADD_DATE) AS PORS_ADD_DATE , MIN(C.ADD_TIME) AS PORS_ADD_TIME , MIN(D.ADD_DATE) AS IVDT_ADD_DATE , MIN(D.ADD_TIME) AS IVDT_ADD_TIME , MIN(D.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE) AS DELIVERY_ADD_DATE , MAX(A.PURCHASER_ID) AS PURCHASER_ID , NVL(MAX((SELECT DELY_TO_CENTER FROM SUPLINFO2 WHERE SUPPLIER = A.AGENT)), MAX(B.WAREHOUSE_CODE)) AS TR_CENTER FROM ICOMIVHD E , ICOMIVDT D , ICOMPOHD A , ICOMPODT B , ICOMPORS C, ICOMPRDT F WHERE 1=1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMIVHD WHERE STATUS IN ('C','R') AND BUYER = E.BUYER AND AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND INV_NO = E.INV_NO AND ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMIVHD WHERE STATUS IN ('C','R') AND BUYER = E.BUYER AND AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND INV_NO = E.INV_NO AND INV_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} )
AND (B.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} OR B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_buyer_code})
AND (C.PO_NO IN
UPPER(#{item})
OR B.LEGACY_PO_NO IN
UPPER(#{item})
)
AND E.BUYER = D.BUYER AND E.INV_NO = D.INV_NO AND E.SELLER = D.SELLER AND D.BUYER = C.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND D.DS_DATE= C.DS_DATE AND D.BUYER = B.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND D.BUYER = A.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.BUYER = F.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = F.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = F.PR_SEQ AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND F.STATUS <> 'D'
AND (NVL(D.DELIVERY_QTY,0) > 0 OR NVL(D.GR_QTY,0) > 0 )
AND (NVL(D.DELIVERY_QTY,0) = 0 AND NVL(D.GR_QTY,0) = 0)
GROUP BY D.BUYER , D.PO_NO , D.DS_DATE , D.INV_NO ORDER BY IVDT_ADD_DATE DESC,BUYER_NAME, INV_NO, PO_NO ) S WHERE 1=1
AND S.PARCEL_YN = #{st_parcel_yn}
AND S.INV_NO LIKE UPPER('%'||TRIM(#{st_inv_no})||'%')
AND REPLACE(UPPER(S.BUYER_NAME),' ','') LIKE '%'||UPPER(TRIM(REPLACE(#{st_buyer_name},' ','')))||'%'
)X

/*getSellerMpIvTranStatementWriteQryForReport_v2*/ SELECT COL01_DATA,COL02_DATA,COL03_DATA,COL04_DATA FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = #{BUYER} AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000002'
